description: This PHP source file contains utility functions for testing and demonstration purposes within the TestLink Open Source Project. It includes functions to display sample messages and to run tests with an XML-RPC client, outputting debugging information and handling responses.

methods.name: show_api_db_sample_msg
methods.description: Displays a sample message indicating the script can be run against a sample database in TestLink.

methods.name: runTest
methods.description: Executes a test call with an XML-RPC client, outputs debug information, manages error handling, and returns the response.
